subject.title: fix(memory): exclude extraPaths from shared scope hash to avoid unnecessary reindexing

question: Should same-workspace memory-source agents share one SQLite index by default, and what migration, session-visibility, and SDK contract must ship with that change?
rationale: The PR changes default persisted memory storage and cross-agent/session visibility; automation cannot choose that product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but require an accepted storage/session/API design, migration or rebuild-warning behavior, and latest-head proof before merge.

options.title: Accept workspace as the share boundary
options.body: Maintainers can approve the proposed same-workspace sharing model, but the PR still needs to own the upgrade, privacy, and SDK contract explicitly.

options.title: Defer to the canonical issue
options.body: Pause or close this branch and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95724 as the design tracker until the boundary is settled.

recommendation.title: Redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require an accepted storage/session/API design, migration or rebuild-warning behavior, and latest-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected memory resolver and memory-host paths are strongly tied to this history, and the remaining choice is about the product/storage boundary.
